Asset type: a targeted final revision of this same 74x100 logical-pixel dialogue portrait.
Input roles: Image 1 is the portrait_v1 EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is the original identity reference. Images 3 through 5 are approved Mara, Ivo and Leiya STYLE references. Keep the target man's identity, apparent age, face orientation, sober expression, nose/jaw/cheek proportions, dominant costume palette and tight facial framing. Use identity reference only to correct identity; do not adopt its cartoon eyes or full-body shape. Do not change the person or introduce any new costume or story detail.
ONLY correct the overly thick continuous full beard and shorten the exposed neck while simplifying noisy hair. Preserve mature male Leo identity: dark brown short side-swept hair, light grey small deep-set eyes, straight strong nose, mature firmer fuller face than Hers, worn dark steel neckline and faded blue fabric. Critically: remove the thick continuous black beard ring and goatee beard! Original Leo has very short light stubble. Reduce the many small spiky hair tips into FOUR or FIVE broad matte locks; preserve dark-brown short hair, not longer coiffure. Eyebrows should be steadily nearly straight, calm restrained scrutiny rather than an inward-upward worried brow. The expression is cautious, firm and responsible, not anger, sorrow, or heroic smile.
Rendering remains true coarse hard-cluster pixel art for 74x100 logical pixels, matched to the three approved style anchors. It must look like nearest-neighbor enlargement of that coarse grid even if the returned raster is large. Do not repaint in a high-resolution soft illustration. No micro-texture, dithering, antialiasing, grain, soft gradients, fuzzy edges, high-frequency highlights or scratchy hatching. At most 32 purposeful visible working colors in this batch. Small eyes with subdued whites, clear nostril wings and cheek planes, hard outer silhouette. Nearly entire frame filled by head; crown inside top, tiny collar only at bottom. Preserve genuine transparent alpha outside silhouette. Single character, no props/hands/chest/shoulders, no text, frame or background.
